description: This Java class defines the 'Not' logical operator within the OpenMRS logic operator package. It implements the LogicalOperator interface and provides a string representation for the negation operator.

classes.name: Not
classes.description: A class implementing a logical negation operator, representing 'NOT' in logical expressions within the OpenMRS logic framework.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string 'NOT' to represent the logical negation operator.
